memories.text: single websocket service debug logs are commented out to prevent high-frequency console spam

Plan to replace /mobile-chart WebView with native Flutter candlesticks v3.0.1 (BSD-3-Clause, Skia/CustomPainter, no WebView) as DEFAULT chart, with a floating action button opening a NEW ChartFullscreenScreen route that loads the existing ChartInAppWebView (kept alive for backwards compat).
